duplicate-dialog.headline: Duplicate
duplicate-dialog.text-part1: Create a new event based on your existing event
duplicate-dialog.text-part2: All settings will remain the same and you can choose to also copy over the list of people from your original event.
duplicate-dialog.checkbox-copy-all-people: Copy over all people on the list

admins-dialog.headline: Admins
admins-dialog.text:
Admins you add here can edit all fields on your event, just like you can. Only you can archive and delete the event.

Enter the email address of an existing user.

archive-menu.archive-text: Archived events are moved to a separate page to unclutter your main view.

delete-dialog.headline: Delete event
delete-dialog.text-part1: Are you sure you want to delete the event
delete-dialog.text-part2: The event and all of its attendees will be gone forever!
